_doc: STRAYS-1 policy (foundation/strays.py). code_roots: the top-level directories code may live in; a tracked code file at the repository root or under any other top-level directory fails checks and the branch sweep gate. A new root is added only in the change that also adds what runs it. baseline is shrink-only and empty. workflow_template_dirs: directories of workflow templates an adapter installs into another repository's .github/workflows/; any other workflows/ directory outside .github/ is a decoy GitHub never runs.
